patthana21.3:1.1: Nahetu ceva nahetuvippayutto ca nakusalo dhammo hetussa ceva hetusampayuttassa ca kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ, nava pañhā kātabbā).
patthana21.3:2.1: Nahetu ceva nahetuvippayutto ca naakusalo dhammo hetussa ceva hetusampayuttassa ca akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ, nava pañhā kātabbā).
patthana21.3:3.1: Nahetu ceva nahetuvippayutto ca naabyākato dhammo hetussa ceva hetusampayuttassa ca abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi. (Nava pañhā kātabbā.)
